name: Composio
tagline: Many apps through your own Composio link
description: Composio connects agents to Gmail, Slack, GitHub, and hundreds of other apps through one MCP server. Connect the apps you want in your Composio account, then paste its MCP URL and API key here.

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email and draft replies to the urgent ones.

Which apps and actions can you use through Composio?

apps.name: Composio
